subject: Mutual Action Plan recap: Acme pilot & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + Mutual Action Plan (draft)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap while everything's fresh and a draft MAP attached. High-level takeaways: 

Pain points you confirmed:
- Current vendor has unpredictable per-token costs and frequent cold-start latency spikes (p95 > 800ms) that impact UI fluidity.
- No clear SLA or cost controls for peak traffic.
- Security: need SOC 2 evidence and a plan for data residency for EU transactions (initial pilot in US).

Goals we agreed on:
1) Pilot to demonstrate 40–50% reduction in per-token inference cost or equivalent TCO improvements.
2) Achieve p50 latency under 120ms and p95 under 400ms for typical prompt sizes during the pilot.
3) Validate compliance posture (SOC 2) and confirm roadmap for EU data residency for full rollout.

Draft Mutual Action Plan (milestones & owners):
- M1 (Week 0–2): Pilot kickoff + baseline measurements — Owner: Marissa (Redwood). Target start: 2026-03-22.
- M2 (Week 2–4): Integration & test harness (prefix caching, sample workloads) — Owner: Dev (Redwood). Target: 2026-04-05.
- M3 (Week 4–6): Performance tuning & cost analysis — Owner: Marcus (Redwood) + Acme engineering. Target: 2026-04-19.
- M4 (Week 6–8): Exec decision & procurement — Owner: Maria Gomez (CFO, Acme) / Procurement. Target: 2026-05-03.

Decision process & stakeholders:
- Technical sign-off: Acme Eng (Samantha + Eng leads).
- Budget/contract sign-off: Maria Gomez (CFO) + Procurement.
- Legal/Security review: Acme Security team (SOC 2 evidence required).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm pilot start date (we penciled 2026-03-22).
2) I'll send a 1-page SOW + schedule and a short runbook for the integration.
3) Setup a recurring weekly 30-min sync for progress and blockers (Wednesdays 10am PT?).

Attachments: Acme-RI-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP draft), redwood-performance-benchmarks.xlsx (sample numbers).

If that aligns, I’ll lock the dates and share the SOW draft + DocuSign link for procurement to review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick items from my side:

Hi Sam / Maria / Procurement team —

Appreciate the quick reply. Attached is a short SOW draft (SOW-draft-Acme.docx) and a one‑page ROI snapshot pulled from the benchmark sheet. Short answers: 

Pilot budget (6 weeks): Estimated $18k–$28k depending on traffic profile and whether you want reserved capacity for peak days. We can tighten this after baseline (M1).
Resource ask from Acme Eng: ~40–60 engineer hours during Weeks 1–3 (integration hooks, sample datasets, and validation). We will provide a small integration runbook and one Redwood engineer during that window.

I've updated the MAP to include the decision gate explicitly: 
- Decision gate (M4): CFO Maria Gomez to approve budget after ROI review (target sign-off by 2026-05-03).

Next steps I will take by EOD tomorrow:
- Share DocuSign placeholder for SOW + SOW-draft-Acme.docx.
- Share a 1-page ROI summary for Maria & Finance.
- Propose calendar invites for weekly syncs (Wednesdays 10am PT).

If you confirm the pilot start 2026-03-22, we’ll have engineering ready to start baseline collection on Day 1.

Best,
Marissa

I’ll be on the kickoff 2026-03-22 and can allocate a Redwood engineer for the first two weeks to pair with Acme Eng.
